source.text: Χριστοῦ οὖν παθόντος σαρκὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὁπλίσασθε, ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας, εἰς τὸ μηκέτι ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι θεοῦ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον.

records.literal_gloss: Christ therefore having suffered in flesh, also you the same mind arm yourselves with, because the [one] having suffered in flesh has ceased from sin, \v 2 so as no longer for desires of men but for will of God the remaining in flesh to live time.

en.L: Since {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} therefore suffered in [the] flesh, arm yourselves also with the same way of thinking, because the one who has suffered in [the] flesh has ceased from sin, \v 2 so as to live the remaining time in [the] flesh no longer for [the] desires of {{gender:people|men}} but for [the] will of God.
en.B: So then, since {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} suffered in the body, you too must arm yourselves with the same resolve, because whoever has suffered in the body is done with sin. \v 2 Then you will spend the rest of your time in the body living no longer for human desires but for what God wills.
en.R: Because {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} suffered in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body, get your minds ready to think the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did, like soldiers putting on their armor. Anyone who has suffered in the body has finished with sin. \v 2 So for the rest of your life here on earth, do not live for the things people crave. Live for what God wants.

es.L: Puesto que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, pues, padeció en [la] carne, {{plural_you:ármense|armaos}} también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} del mismo modo de pensar, porque el que ha padecido en [la] carne ha cesado del pecado, \v 2 para vivir el tiempo que queda en [la] carne ya no para [los] deseos de los {{gender:seres humanos|hombres}}, sino para [la] voluntad de Dios.
es.B: Así pues, ya que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} sufrió en el cuerpo, {{plural_you:ármense|armaos}} también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con la misma determinación, porque quien ha sufrido en el cuerpo ha roto con el pecado. \v 2 Así {{plural_you:pasarán|pasaréis}} el resto de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} tiempo en el cuerpo viviendo ya no para los deseos humanos, sino para lo que Dios quiere.
es.R: Como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} sufrió en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo, {{plural_you:prepárense|preparaos}} para pensar como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pensaba, como soldados que se ponen la armadura. Quien ha sufrido en el cuerpo ya ha terminado con el pecado. \v 2 Así que, el resto de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida aquí en la tierra, no {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} para las cosas que la gente desea con ansia. {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} para lo que Dios quiere.

sw.L: Basi, kwa kuwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliteseka katika mwili, ninyi pia jihamini kwa nia ile ile, kwa sababu aliyeteseka katika mwili ameacha dhambi, \v 2 ili muishi muda uliobaki katika mwili, si tena kwa ajili ya tamaa za wanadamu, bali kwa ajili ya mapenzi ya Mungu.
sw.B: Basi, kwa kuwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliteseka katika mwili, ninyi pia jihamini kwa msimamo huo huo, kwa sababu mtu aliyeteseka katika mwili amemalizana na dhambi. \v 2 Hivyo muda wenu uliobaki katika mwili hamtauishi tena kwa ajili ya tamaa za kibinadamu, bali kwa ajili ya kile Mungu anachotaka.
sw.R: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliteseka katika mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kwa hiyo jiandaeni kufikiri kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyofikiri, kama askari wanaojivika silaha zao. Mtu aliyeteseka katika mwili amemalizana na dhambi. \v 2 Kwa hiyo, katika maisha yenu yaliyobaki hapa duniani, msiishi kwa ajili ya mambo ambayo watu wanayatamani. Ishini kwa ajili ya kile Mungu anachotaka.

fr.L: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ayant donc souffert dans [la] chair, vous aussi armez-vous de la même pensée, car celui qui a souffert dans [la] chair en a fini avec le péché, \v 2 afin de vivre le temps qui reste dans [la] chair non plus selon [les] désirs {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}, mais selon [la] volonté de Dieu.
fr.B: Puisque le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a souffert dans le corps, armez-vous donc, vous aussi, de la même résolution, car celui qui a souffert dans le corps en a fini avec le péché. \v 2 Ainsi, vous passerez le reste de votre vie dans le corps à vivre non plus pour les désirs humains, mais pour ce que Dieu veut.
fr.R: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a souffert dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps. Alors préparez-vous à penser comme {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme des soldats qui prennent leurs armes. Celui qui a souffert dans son corps en a fini avec le péché. \v 2 Alors, pour le reste de votre vie ici sur la terre, ne vivez pas pour ce que les gens désirent. Vivez pour ce que Dieu veut.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 육신으로 고난을 받으셨으니, 여러분도 같은 생각으로 무장하십시오. 육신으로 고난을 받은 사람은 죄와 끊어졌기 때문입니다. \v 2 그래서 육신으로 남은 때를 더 이상 사람들의 욕망을 따라 살지 않고 하나님의 뜻을 따라 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 몸으로 고난을 받으셨으니, 여러분도 같은 각오로 무장하십시오. 몸으로 고난을 받은 사람은 죄와 끝을 맺었기 때문입니다. \v 2 그러면 여러분은 몸으로 사는 남은 시간을 더 이상 사람의 욕망을 위해 살지 않고, 하나님께서 원하시는 것을 위해 살게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 몸으로 고난을 받으셨습니다. 그러니 여러분도 그분처럼 생각하도록 마음을 준비하십시오. 군인이 갑옷을 입는 것처럼 하십시오. 몸으로 고난을 받은 사람은 죄와 끝을 낸 사람입니다. \v 2 그러니 이 땅에서 사는 남은 삶 동안, 사람들이 바라는 것을 위해 살지 마십시오. 하나님께서 원하시는 것을 위해 사십시오.

decisions.choice: arm yourselves with the same way of thinking: take up, as a soldier takes up weapons, the resolve Christ had when he suffered
decisions.reason: ὁπλίζομαι is a soldier's word, to put on armor or take up weapons. ἔννοια is a thought, attitude or settled intention. "The same" points back to Christ, who suffered for doing good and entrusted himself to God (2:21-23; 3:18). The readers are to face suffering with his resolve.

decisions.choice: the one who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin: a believer who accepts suffering for doing right has broken with a life of sin
alternatives: Christ, who by suffering and dying was finished with sin once for all (3:18)
the believer who has died with Christ, as in baptism (3:21; Romans 6:7)
suffering itself purifies a person from sin
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on at once to the readers' own life: no longer for human desires but for the will of God (4:2-3). So the one who has suffered is most naturally the believer: choosing to suffer rather than sin shows that the old life is over. The wording, though, echoes 3:18, and some take it of Christ himself; others hear Paul's "whoever has died is set free from sin" (Romans 6:7). The renderings keep the general "whoever" so that the reader can weigh them.

decisions.choice: because: the reason for arming themselves
alternatives: that: the content of the way of thinking, "arm yourselves with this thought, that ..."
decisions.reason: ὅτι can give a reason or state what the thought is. Either way the clause says why the readers should take Christ's resolve; the sense hardly differs, so the renderings use "because".

decisions.choice: flesh: bodily, mortal human life
decisions.reason: In 1 Peter σάρξ is human life in the body, the life that can suffer and die (1:24; 3:18; 4:6). "The remaining time in the flesh" is the rest of one's earthly life, not a struggle with a sinful nature.

decisions.choice: in the body; the rest of your time in the body / your life here on earth
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "flesh". Balanced and Readable say "body", because in English "flesh" suggests a sinful nature, which is not the sense here (m4). Readable says "in his body" of Christ and "your life here on earth" for the remaining time.

decisions.choice: like soldiers putting on their armor; think the way he did
decisions.reason: Readable explains the military picture in the verb (m1) and makes explicit that "the same" way of thinking is Christ's.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Peter writes to the churches in the plural throughout the letter. Each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (the default) or vosotros, as in Paul's letters.

decisions.choice: mwili at every level
decisions.reason: "Mwili" means both flesh and body, so the one word serves Literal's "flesh" and the "body" of Balanced and Readable. It names bodily, mortal life, the sense of the meaning decision (m4), and does not suggest a sinful nature here.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns; "wanadamu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Paul's letters, the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives ("mwili wake", "kama yeye alivyofikiri"); pronouns inside the verb cannot take a capital. "Wanadamu" already means human beings of both sexes, so Swahili has no gender span where the English has "people" / "men".

decisions.choice: passé composé for past events, and the deity_pronoun and christos spans as set out in 1:1 (for this chapter)
decisions.reason: The chapter continues the letter’s address to the readers, so the choices made in 1:1 hold here; "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}" keeps the article outside the span, as in 1:11.

decisions.choice: [les] désirs {{gender:des humains|des hommes}} (L)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (as in 2:4), so the inclusive word is the default and "hommes" the traditional alternative. Balanced and Readable say "humains" and "les gens", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: "육신으로" (L); "몸으로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Flesh here is bodily, mortal human life (meaning decision), not the fallen nature of 2:11. Literal keeps the letter's word "육신", as in 3:18; Balanced and Readable say "몸", as the English says "body".

source.text: ἀρκετὸς γὰρ ὁ παρεληλυθὼς χρόνος τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν κατειργάσθαι, πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις, ἐπιθυμίαις, οἰνοφλυγίαις, κώμοις, πότοις, καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις.

records.literal_gloss: Sufficient for the having passed time the will of the Gentiles to have carried out, having walked in sensualities, lusts, drunkennesses, revels, drinking parties, and lawless idolatries.

en.L: For the time that has passed [is] enough to have carried out the will of the Gentiles, having walked in sensualities, lusts, drunkenness, revels, drinking parties, and lawless idolatries.
en.B: For the time that is behind you was enough for doing as the pagans please: a life of sensuality and lust, drunkenness, wild feasts, drinking parties and forbidden idol worship.
en.R: You have already spent enough of your life doing what people who do not know God like to do. You gave yourselves to shameless living and wrong desires. You got drunk and went to wild parties and drinking feasts, and you worshiped idols, which God forbids.

es.L: Porque el tiempo pasado [es] suficiente para haber cumplido la voluntad de los gentiles, habiendo andado en desenfrenos, pasiones, borracheras, juergas, fiestas de bebida e idolatrías ilícitas.
es.B: El tiempo que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} dejado atrás ya fue suficiente para hacer lo que quieren los paganos: una vida de desenfreno y pasiones, borracheras, juergas, fiestas de bebida y el culto prohibido a los ídolos.
es.R: Ya {{plural_you:han|habéis}} pasado bastante tiempo de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida haciendo lo que le gusta hacer a la gente que no conoce a Dios. {{plural_you:Se entregaron|Os entregasteis}} a una vida sin vergüenza y a malos deseos. {{plural_you:Se emborrachaban|Os emborrachabais}}, {{plural_you:iban|ibais}} a fiestas locas y a banquetes de bebida, y {{plural_you:adoraban|adorabais}} ídolos, cosa que Dios prohíbe.

sw.L: Kwa maana muda uliopita unatosha kwa kuyatimiza matakwa ya watu wa mataifa, [mkiwa] mmeenenda katika anasa, tamaa, ulevi, sherehe za fujo, vikao vya pombe, na ibada za sanamu zilizokatazwa.
sw.B: Muda mlioupitisha zamani ulitosha kwa kufanya yale wanayoyapenda wapagani: maisha ya anasa na tamaa, ulevi, sherehe za fujo, vikao vya pombe na ibada za sanamu zilizokatazwa.
sw.R: Mmekwisha kutumia muda wa kutosha wa maisha yenu kufanya yale wanayopenda kufanya watu wasiomjua Mungu. Mlijitoa kwa maisha ya aibu na tamaa mbaya. Mlilewa, mkaenda kwenye sherehe za fujo na karamu za pombe, na mkaabudu sanamu, jambo ambalo Mungu amekataza.

fr.L: Car il suffit du temps passé pour avoir accompli la volonté des nations, en marchant dans les débauches, les convoitises, les ivrogneries, les orgies, les beuveries et les idolâtries illicites.
fr.B: Il suffit bien du temps que vous avez passé à faire ce qui plaît à ceux qui ne connaissent pas Dieu : une vie de débauche et de convoitise, d’ivrognerie, de fêtes déchaînées, de beuveries et d’idolâtries interdites.
fr.R: Vous avez déjà passé assez de temps de votre vie à faire ce qu’aiment faire les gens qui ne connaissent pas Dieu. Vous vous êtes livrés à une vie sans retenue et à de mauvais désirs. Vous vous êtes enivrés, vous êtes allés à des fêtes déchaînées et à des beuveries, et vous avez adoré des idoles, ce que Dieu interdit.

ko.L: 지나간 때에 이방 사람들이 원하는 것을 행한 것으로 충분합니다. 여러분은 방탕과 욕정과 술 취함과 흥청거리는 잔치와 술판과 불법적인 우상 숭배 가운데 살았습니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 지나간 세월 동안 하나님을 모르는 사람들이 좋아하는 대로 살 만큼 살았습니다. 방탕하고 음란하게 살며, 술에 취하고, 흥청망청 잔치를 벌이고, 술판을 벌이고, 금지된 우상 숭배를 했습니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 이미 오랫동안 하나님을 모르는 사람들이 좋아하는 일을 하며 살았습니다. 여러분은 부끄러운 줄 모르고 살며 나쁜 욕망을 따랐습니다. 술에 취하고, 흥청망청 잔치를 벌이고, 술판을 벌였습니다. 그리고 하나님께서 금하신 우상을 섬겼습니다.

decisions.choice: the Gentiles: the peoples who do not know God, the pagan world the readers came from
decisions.reason: ἔθνος means the nations, and so those outside God's people. The readers themselves had lived this way "in ignorance" (1:14) and had inherited an empty way of life (1:18), so the word here means the pagan world around them, not simply people who are not Jews.

decisions.choice: enough: more than enough, a dry understatement
decisions.reason: Saying the past time "is enough" for such a life means it has gone on long enough and must stop.

decisions.choice: a list of the behavior of pagan feasts and festivals
decisions.reason: ἀσέλγεια is behavior without restraint; κῶμος were rowdy feasts or street processions with drinking; πότος were drinking parties. Such feasts were often held in honor of a god, at temples, festivals and trade-guild meals, so the list ends with idol worship. ἀθέμιτος means unlawful or abhorrent: forbidden by God's law.

decisions.choice: having walked: "you" are the ones who lived this way
decisions.reason: The participle is plural and refers to the readers, though the sentence does not name them. "Walk" is the common biblical picture for how one lives.

decisions.choice: the pagans; people who do not know God
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "Gentiles". Balanced and Readable avoid it because the readers were themselves mostly not Jews; the contrast is with those who do not know God (m1).

decisions.choice: "the time that is behind you"; "you have spent enough of your life"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name "you" at the start so that the reader knows whose past is meant (m4).

decisions.choice: los paganos (B); la gente que no conoce a Dios (R)
decisions.reason: "Gentiles" is the settled word where the contrast is with Jews, and Literal keeps it. Here the meaning decision (m1) says the word means the pagan world the readers themselves came from, so Balanced says "paganos" and Readable "la gente que no conoce a Dios", not "los que no son judíos".

decisions.choice: wapagani (B); watu wasiomjua Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Watu wa mataifa" is the settled phrase where the contrast is with Jews, and Literal keeps it. Here the meaning decision (m1) says the word means the pagan world the readers came from, so Balanced says "wapagani" and Readable "watu wasiomjua Mungu", not "watu wasio Wayahudi".

decisions.choice: des nations (L); ceux qui ne connaissent pas Dieu (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:12: "païens", which the English Balanced uses ("pagans"), sounds pejorative in French or suggests people with no religion at all. Balanced says what the word means here (meaning decision m1).

source.text: ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν, βλασφημοῦντες· οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ἔχοντι κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς·

records.literal_gloss: In which they are surprised, not running together you into the same of debauchery flood, slandering; \v 5 who will give account to the [one] readily having to judge living and dead;

en.L: In this they are surprised, since you do not run with [them] into the same flood of dissipation, slandering [you], \v 5 who will give an account to the one who is ready to judge [the] living and [the] dead.
en.B: They are surprised that you no longer plunge with them into the same flood of wild and wasteful living, and so they speak evil of you. \v 5 They will answer for this to the one who stands ready to judge both the living and the dead.
en.R: People who do not know God think it is strange that you no longer rush with them into the same wild and wasteful way of life. So they say bad things about you. \v 5 But they will have to explain themselves to the one who is ready to judge everyone, both the living and the dead.

es.L: En esto se extrañan, porque {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:corren|corréis}} [con ellos] hacia el mismo torrente de libertinaje, y [{{plural_you:los|os}}] calumnian; \v 5 ellos darán cuenta al que está preparado para juzgar a [los] vivos y a [los] muertos.
es.B: Les extraña que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ya no {{plural_you:se lancen|os lancéis}} con ellos al mismo torrente de vida sin freno y derrochadora, y por eso hablan mal de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 5 Ellos tendrán que responder ante aquel que está preparado para juzgar a los vivos y a los muertos.
es.R: La gente que no conoce a Dios se extraña de que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ya no {{plural_you:corran|corráis}} con ellos hacia esa misma vida loca y derrochadora. Por eso hablan mal de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 5 Pero tendrán que dar explicaciones ante el que está preparado para juzgar a todos, tanto a los vivos como a los muertos.

sw.L: Katika jambo hili wanashangaa kwamba hamkimbii pamoja [nao] kuingia katika mafuriko yale yale ya maisha ya ubadhirifu, wakiwatukana; \v 5 hao watamtolea hesabu yeye aliye tayari kuwahukumu walio hai na wafu.
sw.B: Wanashangaa kwamba hamjiungi tena nao kujitosa katika mafuriko yale yale ya maisha ya anasa na ubadhirifu, na hivyo wanawasema vibaya. \v 5 Watajibu kwa hilo mbele ya yule aliye tayari kuwahukumu walio hai na wafu.
sw.R: Watu wasiomjua Mungu wanaona ajabu kwamba hamkimbii tena pamoja nao katika maisha yale yale ya fujo na ubadhirifu. Kwa hiyo wanawasema vibaya. \v 5 Lakini watalazimika kujieleza mbele ya yule aliye tayari kumhukumu kila mtu, walio hai na waliokufa.

fr.L: En cela ils s’étonnent que vous ne couriez pas avec [eux] dans le même débordement de débauche, [vous] calomniant, \v 5 eux qui rendront compte à celui qui est prêt à juger [les] vivants et [les] morts.
fr.B: Ils trouvent étrange que vous ne vous jetiez plus avec eux dans le même torrent de vie déréglée et de gaspillage, et c’est pourquoi ils disent du mal de vous. \v 5 Ils en rendront compte à celui qui est prêt à juger les vivants et les morts.
fr.R: Les gens qui ne connaissent pas Dieu trouvent étrange que vous ne couriez plus avec eux vers la même vie folle et gaspillée. Alors ils disent du mal de vous. \v 5 Mais ils devront s’expliquer devant celui qui est prêt à juger tout le monde, les vivants et les morts.

ko.L: 이 일에서 그들은 여러분이 같은 방탕의 홍수 속으로 함께 달려가지 않는 것을 이상하게 여기며 [여러분을] 비방합니다. \v 5 그들은 산 사람들과 죽은 사람들을 심판하실 준비가 되어 있는 분께 셈을 해 드려야 할 것입니다.
ko.B: 그들은 여러분이 더 이상 그들과 함께 거칠고 방탕한 생활의 홍수 속으로 뛰어들지 않는 것을 이상하게 여기고, 여러분을 헐뜯습니다. \v 5 그들은 산 사람과 죽은 사람을 심판하려고 준비하고 계신 분 앞에서 이 일에 대해 답해야 할 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님을 모르는 사람들은 여러분이 더 이상 그들과 함께 거칠고 방탕한 삶으로 몰려가지 않는 것을 이상하게 여깁니다. 그래서 여러분을 나쁘게 말합니다. \v 5 그러나 그들은 모든 사람, 곧 살아 있는 사람과 죽은 사람을 심판하실 준비가 되어 있는 분 앞에서 자기가 한 일을 설명해야 할 것입니다.

decisions.choice: one sentence through 4:5: the relative clause "who will give account" continues 4:4
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has a raised dot after 4:4, but 4:5 begins with the relative pronoun οἳ, "who", referring to those who slander. It finishes the thought of 4:4 and does not stand on its own, so the record runs to the end of 4:5. Balanced and Readable may still start a new sentence there.

decisions.choice: run with them into the same flood of dissipation: rush with the crowd into reckless excess
decisions.reason: συντρέχω is to run together, as a crowd does. ἀνάχυσις is an outpouring or flood, and ἀσωτία is reckless, wasteful living (the adverb is used of the younger son in Luke 15:13). The former friends are surprised that the believers no longer join them.

decisions.choice: slander: they speak abusively of the believers
decisions.reason: βλασφημέω means to speak insultingly, whether of people or of God. The letter elsewhere says that outsiders speak against the believers as evildoers (2:12; 3:16), so they are most likely the object here. Since the word can also mean blasphemy against God, a footnote gives that sense.

decisions.choice: the one who is ready to judge: left unnamed, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: In 1 Peter the Father judges each one impartially (1:17; 2:23), but elsewhere Christ is the one appointed to judge the living and the dead (Acts 10:42; 2 Timothy 4:1). Peter does not say which he means, and the renderings leave it open. Either way the slanderers will answer to God, and the believers need not answer them in kind.

decisions.choice: the living and the dead: all people, those alive when the judgment comes and those who have died before it
decisions.reason: The phrase is a standard way of saying "everyone" (Acts 10:42; Romans 14:9). It leads into 4:6, which speaks of the dead.

decisions.choice: with them; of you
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves out the object of "run with" and of "slander". Literal supplies them in brackets; Balanced and Readable supply them without (m3). Readable also names the subject, "people who do not know God", from 4:3.

decisions.choice: "심판하실 준비가 되어 있는 분" with the honorific, the judge left unnamed
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves the judge unnamed, as the Greek does (God, or Christ). Korean marks him with the honorific -시- and "분" without choosing a name.

source.text: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκὶ ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ θεὸν πνεύματι.

records.literal_gloss: For to this also to dead [ones] the gospel was preached, that they might be judged on the one hand according to men in flesh, might live on the other hand according to God in spirit.

en.L: For to this [end] the gospel was preached also to [the] dead, so that, though they are judged according to {{gender:people|men}} in [the] flesh, they might live according to God in [the] spirit.
en.B: This is why the gospel was preached even to those who are dead: so that, though by human reckoning they were judged in the body, by God's reckoning they might live in the spirit.
en.R: That is why the good news was told even to people who have now died. By human standards they were judged, and their bodies died. But God's purpose was that, in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sight, they would live in the spirit.

es.L: Porque para esto se anunció el evangelio también a [los] muertos: para que, aunque sean juzgados según los {{gender:seres humanos|hombres}} en [la] carne, vivan según Dios en [el] espíritu.
es.B: Por esto se anunció el evangelio incluso a los que están muertos: para que, aunque a juicio humano fueran juzgados en el cuerpo, a juicio de Dios vivan en el espíritu.
es.R: Por eso la buena noticia se anunció incluso a personas que ya han muerto. Según el criterio humano, fueron juzgados, y sus cuerpos murieron. Pero el propósito de Dios era que, a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, vivieran en el espíritu.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa ajili ya hili Injili ilihubiriwa hata kwa wafu, ili kwamba, ingawa walihukumiwa kwa kadiri ya wanadamu katika mwili, waishi kwa kadiri ya Mungu katika roho.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu Injili ilihubiriwa hata kwa wale waliokufa: ili, ingawa kwa kipimo cha kibinadamu walihukumiwa katika mwili, kwa kipimo cha Mungu waishi katika roho.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu Habari Njema ilitangazwa hata kwa watu ambao sasa wamekwisha kufa. Kwa kipimo cha wanadamu walihukumiwa, na miili yao ikafa. Lakini kusudi la Mungu lilikuwa kwamba, machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, waishi katika roho.

fr.L: Car c’est pour cela que l’Évangile a été annoncé aussi à [des] morts, afin que, jugés selon {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} dans [la] chair, ils vivent selon Dieu dans [l’]esprit.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi l’Évangile a été annoncé même à ceux qui sont morts : afin que, jugés dans leur corps selon le point de vue humain, ils vivent dans l’esprit selon le point de vue de Dieu.
fr.R: Voilà pourquoi la bonne nouvelle a été annoncée même à des gens qui sont maintenant morts. Aux yeux des humains, ils ont été jugés, et leur corps est mort. Mais Dieu voulait qu’à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, ils vivent dans l’esprit.

ko.L: 이 때문에 죽은 사람들에게도 복음이 전해졌습니다. 이는 그들이 육신으로는 사람들을 따라 심판을 받았으나, 영으로는 하나님을 따라 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 바로 이 때문에 지금은 죽은 사람들에게도 복음이 전해졌습니다. 그것은 그들이 사람이 보기에는 몸으로 심판을 받았지만, 하나님께서 보시기에는 영으로 살게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 지금은 죽은 사람들에게도 기쁜 소식이 전해졌습니다. 사람들이 보기에 그들은 심판을 받았고, 그들의 몸은 죽었습니다. 그러나 하나님의 뜻은 하나님께서 보시기에 그들이 영으로 살게 하시려는 것이었습니다.

decisions.choice: the dead: believers who heard the gospel while they were alive and have since died
alternatives: the dead in the realm of the dead, to whom Christ proclaimed after his death (compare 3:19)
the spiritually dead, people dead in sin
decisions.reason: The verb is past ("was preached"), and the gospel in this letter is the message preached to the readers in their lifetime (1:12, 1:25). The verse explains 4:5: some who believed have already died, as all people do, and the slanderers may think that proves their faith was empty; but the gospel was preached to them so that they would live with God. Many read the verse with 3:19 as a preaching of Christ to the dead after his death; but 3:19 speaks of spirits in prison and uses a different verb, and nothing in this verse says the preaching happened after death. The question is long debated, so a footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: a contrast between human and divine verdicts: judged in the flesh as humans see it, alive in the spirit as God sees it
alternatives: judged by human persecutors, but alive by God's verdict
judged as all humans are, but alive as God is alive
decisions.reason: The two halves are balanced: "according to humans ... in flesh" against "according to God ... in spirit". The first half is concessive: "though they were judged". κατά with a person can mean "by the standard of" or "in the way of"; both fit, and both set what people see against what God does.

decisions.choice: judged: the death that falls on every human being, which looks like a final verdict
decisions.reason: If the dead are believers who have died (m1), the judgment they underwent in the flesh is most naturally death itself, the sentence that falls on all people. Some take it of being condemned or even put to death by human courts; the letter does speak of believers suffering at human hands (4:12-16).

decisions.choice: in flesh ... in spirit: in bodily life ... in the life of the spirit that God gives
decisions.reason: The pair repeats what was said of Christ in 3:18, "put to death in the flesh, made alive in the spirit". What happened to him will happen to those who belong to him. πνεῦμα here is the sphere of life God gives, not first the Holy Spirit as a person.

decisions.choice: those who are dead; people who have now died
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the dead". Balanced says "those who are dead". Readable adds "now" to make the reading of m1 plain: they were alive when they heard. Because that reading is debated, the expansion is marked uncertain.

decisions.choice: they were judged, and their bodies died
decisions.reason: Readable says what the judgment in the flesh was (m3). It goes beyond what the Greek states, so reviewers should weigh it.

decisions.choice: "지금은 죽은 사람들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the dead as believers who heard the gospel while alive and have since died, and footnotes the other readings. "지금은" (now) says so, as the English Balanced does with "those who are dead".

records.literal_gloss: Of all things now the end has drawn near.

en.L: Now the end of all things has drawn near.
en.B: The end of all things is near.
en.R: The end of everything is coming soon.

es.L: Ahora bien, el fin de todas las cosas se ha acercado.
es.B: El fin de todas las cosas está cerca.
es.R: El fin de todo llegará pronto.

sw.L: Lakini mwisho wa vitu vyote umekaribia.
sw.B: Mwisho wa vitu vyote uko karibu.
sw.R: Mwisho wa kila kitu unakuja hivi karibuni.

fr.L: Or la fin de toutes choses s’est approchée.
fr.B: La fin de toutes choses est proche.
fr.R: La fin de tout arrive bientôt.

ko.L: 이제 모든 것의 끝이 가까이 왔습니다.
ko.R: 모든 것이 끝날 때가 곧 옵니다.

decisions.choice: the end of all things: the close of this age, when Christ is revealed and God judges
alternatives: the goal or purpose of all things
decisions.reason: τέλος can mean goal, but here it follows the judgment of the living and the dead (4:5) and leads to the judgment of 4:17. The letter looks for the revealing of Jesus Christ (1:5, 1:7, 1:13) as the end of the present age.

decisions.choice: has drawn near: the end is now close at hand
decisions.reason: The perfect tense says that the end has come near and is now close. The same verb announces the nearness of God's kingdom in Mark 1:15 and the Lord's coming in James 5:8.

source.text: σωφρονήσατε οὖν καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς·

records.literal_gloss: Be of sound mind therefore and be sober for prayers;

en.L: Therefore be of sound mind and be sober for [the sake of] prayers.
en.B: So be sensible and keep a clear head for the sake of your prayers.
en.R: So think clearly and control yourselves. Then you will be able to pray.

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:sean|sed}} sensatos y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} sobrios para [las] oraciones.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:sean|sed}} sensatos y {{plural_you:mantengan|mantened}} la mente despejada, en bien de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} oraciones.
es.R: Por eso, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} con claridad y {{plural_you:contrólense|controlaos}}. Así {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} orar.

sw.L: Basi muwe na akili timamu na muwe na kiasi kwa ajili ya maombi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo muwe na busara na akili iliyotulia kwa ajili ya maombi yenu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo fikirini kwa makini na mjitawale. Ndipo mtaweza kuomba.

fr.L: Soyez donc sensés et sobres en vue des prières.
fr.B: Soyez donc raisonnables et gardez la tête claire pour pouvoir prier.
fr.R: Alors réfléchissez bien et maîtrisez-vous. Ainsi, vous pourrez prier.

ko.L: 그러므로 정신을 바르게 하고 기도하기 위하여 깨어 있으십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 분별력을 가지고, 기도할 수 있도록 맑은 정신을 지키십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 생각을 맑게 하고 자신을 다스리십시오. 그래야 기도할 수 있습니다.

decisions.choice: be of sound mind and sober: keep calm good judgment and a clear head
alternatives: fasting or abstaining from wine as such
decisions.reason: σωφρονέω is to think sensibly, with self-control. νήφω is literally to be sober, not drunk, and is used in 1:13 and 5:8 for a clear, watchful mind. The nearness of the end calls for steady judgment, not panic or excitement; and the readers have left drunkenness behind (4:3).

decisions.choice: for prayers: so that they can pray
decisions.reason: εἰς with the accusative gives the purpose: a clear mind serves prayer. Compare Jesus' "stay awake and pray" (Mark 14:38).

decisions.choice: be sensible and keep a clear head; think clearly and control yourselves
decisions.reason: Plain words for the two verbs. "Sober" alone could suggest only abstaining from alcohol, which is part of the picture but not the whole of it (m1).

source.text: πρὸ πάντων τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ ἔχοντες, ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Before all things the toward yourselves love constant having, because love covers a multitude of sins;

en.L: Above all, have constant love for one another, because love covers a multitude of sins.
en.B: Most important of all, keep your love for one another strong and unfailing, because love covers a great many sins.
en.R: Most important of all, keep on loving each other with all your heart. Love covers over many sins, because it forgives.

es.L: Sobre todo, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} un amor constante unos por otros, porque el amor cubre multitud de pecados.
es.B: Lo más importante de todo: {{plural_you:mantengan|mantened}} fuerte y constante el amor de unos por otros, porque el amor cubre una gran cantidad de pecados.
es.R: Lo más importante de todo es que {{plural_you:sigan amándose|sigáis amándoos}} unos a otros de todo corazón. El amor cubre muchos pecados, porque perdona.

sw.L: Zaidi ya yote, muwe na upendo wa kudumu ninyi kwa ninyi, kwa sababu upendo hufunika wingi wa dhambi.
sw.B: Jambo kuu kuliko yote, dumisheni upendo wenu ninyi kwa ninyi, uwe imara na usiokoma, kwa sababu upendo hufunika dhambi nyingi sana.
sw.R: Jambo kuu kuliko yote, endeleeni kupendana kwa moyo wote. Upendo hufunika dhambi nyingi, kwa sababu husamehe.

fr.L: Avant tout, ayez les uns pour les autres un amour constant, car l’amour couvre une multitude de péchés.
fr.B: Avant tout, gardez entre vous un amour fort et sans faille, car l’amour couvre un grand nombre de péchés.
fr.R: Le plus important, c’est de continuer à vous aimer les uns les autres de tout votre cœur. L’amour couvre beaucoup de péchés, parce qu’il pardonne.

ko.L: 무엇보다도 서로 뜨겁게 사랑하십시오. 사랑은 많은 죄를 덮기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 무엇보다도 서로를 향한 사랑을 늘 뜨겁게 지키십시오. 사랑은 많은 죄를 덮어 줍니다.
ko.R: 무엇보다 중요한 것은, 온 마음으로 서로 계속 사랑하는 것입니다. 사랑은 용서하기 때문에 많은 죄를 덮어 줍니다.

decisions.choice: having: a command, continuing the commands of 4:7
alternatives: a participle depending on "be sober": "be sober ... having love"
decisions.reason: Peter often uses a participle with the force of a command after a main imperative (compare 2:18; 3:1, 3:7). The verb ἔχοντες carries on the instructions of 4:7 and adds the most important of them.

decisions.choice: constant, unfailing: love kept at full stretch
decisions.reason: ἐκτενής means stretched out, and so earnest, sustained, persevering. The adverb from the same root describes the love of 1:22. The stress is on love that keeps going under strain, not only on warmth of feeling.

decisions.choice: love covers a multitude of sins: an echo of Proverbs 10:12
decisions.reason: Proverbs 10:12 sets hatred, which stirs up quarrels, against love, which covers all offenses. Peter's wording is closer to the Hebrew of that verse than to its old Greek translation. James 5:20 uses the same phrase.

decisions.choice: covers: love forgives and overlooks the wrongs of others, so that they do not tear the community apart
alternatives: love wins God's forgiveness for the loving person's own sins
decisions.reason: In Proverbs 10:12 covering is the opposite of stirring up strife, and here the love is "for one another". The point is how believers treat each other's failings, not a way of earning forgiveness; the letter grounds forgiveness in Christ's death (2:24; 3:18).

decisions.choice: because it forgives
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of covering sins in the sense of m4.

decisions.choice: cubre multitud de pecados (L); cubre una gran cantidad de pecados (B)
decisions.reason: The same saying is in James 5:20, and the wording matches the Spanish there ("cubrirá multitud de pecados", "una gran cantidad de pecados") so that a reader can see the two letters use one phrase.

decisions.choice: hufunika wingi wa dhambi (L); hufunika dhambi nyingi sana (B)
decisions.reason: The same saying is in James 5:20, and the wording matches the Swahili there ("atafunika wingi wa dhambi", "dhambi nyingi sana") so that a reader can see the two letters use one phrase. "Kufunika" (to cover) keeps the picture of Proverbs 10:12; Readable adds "husamehe" (it forgives), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "사랑" for love at every level
decisions.reason: "사랑" is the word for this love throughout the Korean New Testament; it keeps the link with "love covers" in Proverbs 10:12 (meaning decision).

records.literal_gloss: Hospitable to one another without grumbling;

en.L: [Be] hospitable to one another without grumbling.
en.B: Welcome one another into your homes without complaining.
en.R: Open your homes to each other, and do not complain about it.

es.L: [{{plural_you:Sean|Sed}}] hospitalarios unos con otros, sin murmuración.
es.B: {{plural_you:Recíbanse|Recibíos}} unos a otros en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} casas sin {{plural_you:quejarse|quejaros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Abran|Abrid}} las puertas de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa unos a otros, y no {{plural_you:se quejen|os quejéis}} por ello.

sw.L: [Muwe] wenye kuwakaribisha wageni ninyi kwa ninyi bila kunung'unika.
sw.R: Karibishaneni nyumbani kwenu, wala msilalamike kuhusu jambo hilo.

fr.L: [Soyez] hospitaliers les uns envers les autres, sans murmurer.
fr.B: Accueillez-vous les uns les autres chez vous, sans vous plaindre.
fr.R: Ouvrez votre maison les uns aux autres, et ne vous en plaignez pas.

ko.B: 불평하지 말고 서로 집에 맞아들여 대접하십시오.
ko.R: 서로 여러분의 집을 열어 손님을 맞아들이고, 그 일로 불평하지 마십시오.

decisions.choice: hospitable: giving guests food and a place to stay
decisions.reason: φιλόξενος means loving strangers, that is, receiving guests. Believers who traveled depended on fellow believers for lodging, and churches met in homes (Romans 16:5; 3 John 5-8). Doing this often was costly, which is why Peter adds "without grumbling".

decisions.choice: a command with no verb, continuing the list of 4:7-8
decisions.reason: The sentence has only an adjective; the force of "be" carries over from the commands before it.

decisions.choice: welcome into your homes; open your homes
decisions.reason: "Hospitality" can sound like general friendliness; naming the home makes the practice clear (m1).

decisions.choice: wenye kuwakaribisha wageni
decisions.reason: "Mkarimu" can mean hospitable, but it is also the everyday word for generous. As in Romans 12:13, hospitality is said as welcoming guests, which names the practice the meaning decision describes (m1).

source.text: ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα, εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Each as he received a gift, to yourselves it serving as good stewards of varied grace of God;

en.L: As each has received a gift, serve one another with it as good stewards of the varied grace of God.
en.B: Each of you has received a gift; use it to serve one another, as good managers of the richly varied grace of God.
en.R: God has given each of you a gift. Use it to serve each other. God's grace comes in many different forms, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has trusted you to look after it well, the way a good manager looks after a household for its owner.

es.L: Según cada uno ha recibido un don, {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} con él los unos a los otros como buenos mayordomos de la variada gracia de Dios.
es.B: Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha recibido un don; {{plural_you:úsenlo|usadlo}} para {{plural_you:servirse|serviros}} unos a otros, como buenos administradores de la gracia de Dios en toda su variedad.
es.R: Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado un don a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Úsenlo|Usadlo}} para {{plural_you:servirse|serviros}} unos a otros. La gracia de Dios se presenta de muchas formas, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha confiado la tarea de cuidarla bien, como un buen administrador cuida una casa para su dueño.

sw.L: Kama kila mmoja alivyopokea karama, itumieni kuhudumiana ninyi kwa ninyi, kama mawakili wazuri wa neema ya Mungu ya namna nyingi.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wenu amepokea karama; itumieni kuhudumiana, kama wasimamizi wazuri wa neema ya Mungu iliyo ya aina nyingi.
sw.R: Mungu amempa kila mmoja wenu karama. Itumieni kuhudumiana. Neema ya Mungu inakuja kwa namna nyingi tofauti, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amewakabidhi jukumu la kuitunza vizuri, kama msimamizi mzuri anavyotunza nyumba kwa ajili ya mwenye nyumba.

fr.L: Comme chacun a reçu un don, mettez-le au service les uns des autres, comme de bons intendants de la grâce variée de Dieu.
fr.B: Chacun de vous a reçu un don ; mettez-le au service des autres, en bons gérants de la grâce si diverse de Dieu.
fr.R: Dieu a donné un don à chacun de vous. Utilisez-le pour vous aider les uns les autres. La grâce de Dieu prend beaucoup de formes différentes, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a confié le soin de bien vous en occuper, comme un bon gérant s’occupe d’une maison pour son propriétaire.

ko.L: 각 사람이 은사를 받은 대로, 하나님의 여러 가지 은혜를 맡은 선한 청지기로서 그것으로 서로 섬기십시오.
ko.B: 여러분은 저마다 은사를 받았습니다. 하나님의 여러 가지 은혜를 맡은 선한 관리인답게, 그 은사로 서로 섬기십시오.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 여러분 각 사람에게 선물을 주셨습니다. 그 선물로 서로 섬기십시오. 하나님의 은혜는 여러 가지 모양으로 옵니다. 하나님께서는 여러분이 그 은혜를 잘 관리하도록 맡기셨습니다. 좋은 관리인이 주인을 위해 집안을 잘 돌보는 것처럼 하십시오.

decisions.choice: a gift: an ability given by God's grace, to be used for others
decisions.reason: χάρισμα comes from the same root as χάρις, grace: it is a gift of grace. Paul uses the word for the various abilities God gives believers to serve the church (Romans 12:6; 1 Corinthians 12:4). Every believer has one ("each").

decisions.choice: stewards: household managers who handle what belongs to their master
decisions.reason: An οἰκονόμος ran a household or estate for its owner, often as a trusted slave (Luke 12:42; 16:1-2). The gifts are not the believers' own property; they manage them for God and will give account.

decisions.choice: varied: many-sided, of many kinds
decisions.reason: ποικίλος means many-colored or various. The letter used the same word of the "various trials" in 1:6: God's grace is as varied as the trials.

decisions.choice: serving: a command, like the participle in 4:8
decisions.reason: The participle διακονοῦντες has the force of a command. It is plural although its subject is "each": every one of them is to use a gift.

decisions.choice: managers; a good manager who looks after a household for its owner
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "stewards". "Steward" is now rare in everyday English, so Balanced says "managers", and Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: mayordomos (L); administradores (B)
decisions.reason: "Mayordomo" is the old word for the manager of a household, close to the Greek picture (m2), and Literal keeps it. Balanced uses the everyday "administradores", and Readable explains the picture, as the English does. "Don" for the gift matches Romans 12:6.

decisions.choice: karama; mawakili (L), wasimamizi (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Karama" is the word for a gift of grace in Romans 12:6, and it is kept here. Literal says "mawakili" (stewards); Balanced and Readable use "msimamizi", one who manages a household for its owner, as the English moves from "stewards" to "managers".

decisions.choice: intendants (L); gérants (B); un bon gérant (R)
decisions.reason: The word is for a household manager who handles what belongs to his master (meaning decision m2). "Économe" is the traditional word but now suggests someone who saves money; "intendant" keeps the household office at Literal, and "gérant" is the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "은사" (L, B); "선물" (R); "청지기" (L); "관리인" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "은사" is the established word for a gift of grace given for others, as in the Korean Romans 12:6. The steward is a household manager who handles what belongs to his master (meaning decision); "청지기" is the familiar Bible word, and Balanced and Readable use the plain "관리인".

source.text: εἴ τις λαλεῖ, ὡς λόγια θεοῦ· εἴ τις διακονεῖ, ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ θεός· ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: If anyone speaks, as oracles of God; if anyone serves, as from strength which supplies God; so that in all things may be glorified God through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory and the power to the ages of the ages; amen.

en.L: If anyone speaks, [let it be] as [the] oracles of God; if anyone serves, [let it be] as from [the] strength that God supplies; so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, to whom belong the glory and the power to the ages of the ages. Amen.
en.B: Whoever speaks must speak as one bringing God's own words. Whoever serves must serve in the strength God supplies. Then in everything God will be glorified through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} belong glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
en.R: If you speak, speak as someone who is passing on God's own words. If you serve, serve with the strength God gives you. Then God will be glorified in everything through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. Glory and power belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} forever and ever. Amen.

es.L: Si alguno habla, [que sea] como [los] oráculos de Dios; si alguno sirve, [que sea] como por [la] fuerza que Dios suministra; para que en todo sea glorificado Dios por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, de quien es la gloria y el poder por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
es.B: El que habla, que hable como quien transmite las palabras mismas de Dios. El que sirve, que sirva con la fuerza que Dios da. Así, en todo, Dios será glorificado por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}. A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pertenecen la gloria y el poder por siempre jamás. Amén.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:hablen|habléis}}, {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}} como quien comunica las palabras mismas de Dios. Cuando {{plural_you:sirvan|sirváis}}, {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} con la fuerza que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} da. Así Dios será glorificado en todo por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}. La gloria y el poder le pertenecen a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por siempre jamás. Amén.

sw.L: Mtu yeyote akisema, [na iwe] kama kauli za Mungu; mtu yeyote akihudumu, [na iwe] kama kwa nguvu ambayo Mungu huitoa; ili katika mambo yote Mungu atukuzwe kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ambaye utukufu na uweza ni vyake hata enzi za enzi. Amina.
sw.B: Anayesema na aseme kama mtu anayeleta maneno ya Mungu mwenyewe. Anayehudumu na ahudumu kwa nguvu ambayo Mungu humpa. Hivyo katika kila jambo Mungu atatukuzwa kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Utukufu na uweza ni {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} milele na milele. Amina.
sw.R: Mkisema, semeni kama watu wanaopeleka maneno ya Mungu mwenyewe. Mkihudumu, hudumuni kwa nguvu ambayo Mungu huwapa. Ndipo Mungu atatukuzwa katika kila jambo kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Utukufu na nguvu ni {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} milele na milele. Amina.

fr.L: Si quelqu’un parle, [que ce soit] comme des oracles de Dieu ; si quelqu’un sert, [que ce soit] comme par la force que Dieu fournit ; afin qu’en toutes choses Dieu soit glorifié par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, à qui appartiennent la gloire et la puissance pour les siècles des siècles. Amen.
fr.B: Celui qui parle doit parler comme quelqu’un qui transmet les paroles mêmes de Dieu. Celui qui sert doit servir avec la force que Dieu donne. Alors, en toutes choses, Dieu sera glorifié par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent la gloire et la puissance pour les siècles des siècles. Amen.
fr.R: Si vous parlez, parlez comme quelqu’un qui transmet les paroles mêmes de Dieu. Si vous servez, servez avec la force que Dieu vous donne. Alors Dieu sera glorifié en tout par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. La gloire et la puissance {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent pour toujours et à jamais. Amen.

ko.L: 누가 말하면 하나님의 말씀처럼 [하고], 누가 섬기면 하나님께서 공급하시는 힘으로 하듯이 [하십시오]. 이는 모든 일에서 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 하나님께서 영광을 받으시게 하려는 것입니다. 영광과 능력이 영원무궁하도록 그분께 있습니다. 아멘.
ko.B: 말하는 사람은 하나님의 말씀을 전하는 사람답게 말하십시오. 섬기는 사람은 하나님께서 주시는 힘으로 섬기십시오. 그러면 모든 일에서 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 하나님께서 영광을 받으실 것입니다. 영광과 능력이 영원히 그분께 있습니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 말을 하는 사람은 하나님께서 주신 말씀을 전하는 사람처럼 말하십시오. 섬기는 사람은 하나님께서 주시는 힘으로 섬기십시오. 그러면 모든 일에서 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 하나님께서 영광을 받으실 것입니다. 영광과 능력이 영원히 그분께 있습니다. 아멘.

decisions.choice: oracles of God: words that come from God
decisions.reason: λόγιον means a divine saying (Acts 7:38; Romans 3:2). The one who speaks in the church is to speak as one handling God's own words, with care and seriousness, not to treat whatever he says as Scripture.

decisions.choice: two kinds of gifts, speaking and serving, each with its verb left out
decisions.reason: The gifts of 4:10 are summed up in two kinds: speaking (teaching, encouraging) and serving (practical help). Each clause leaves out a verb such as "let it be"; the sense is how the gift is to be used.

decisions.choice: to whom: to God, who is glorified through Jesus Christ
alternatives: to Jesus Christ, the nearest name
decisions.reason: The relative pronoun could refer to Jesus Christ, the nearest name, and doxologies to Christ do occur (2 Peter 3:18; Revelation 1:5-6). But God is the subject of the sentence, and the closing doxology of the letter gives power to God (5:10-11). The renderings say "him", which can be read either way; a footnote notes the question.

decisions.choice: belong: a statement, not a wish
alternatives: be (a prayer that glory may be his)
decisions.reason: The verb ἐστιν is indicative: glory and power are his. Many doxologies leave the verb out, and translations often supply "be"; here Peter states it.

decisions.choice: to the ages of the ages: forever
decisions.reason: A Hebrew-style way of saying "for all time", as in Galatians 1:5 and Hebrews 13:21.

decisions.choice: if you speak; if you serve
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the readers directly, as the commands of 4:7-10 do. It applies to each of them just as "anyone" does.

decisions.choice: forever and ever
alternatives: to the ages of the ages
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek phrase; Balanced and Readable use the English idiom with the same meaning (m5).

decisions.choice: ni vyake; hata enzi za enzi (L), milele na milele (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek states that glory and power are his (m4), so Swahili says "ni vyake" (they are his), not a wish such as "uwe kwake". "Vyake" agrees with the two nouns together and, like the English "him", can refer to God or to Jesus Christ (m3). Literal keeps "the ages of the ages" as "enzi za enzi"; Balanced and Readable use the idiom "milele na milele".

decisions.choice: pour les siècles des siècles (L, B); pour toujours et à jamais (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in Hebrews: the French idiom built on the same Greek phrase, meaning forever (meaning decision m5); Readable uses the everyday phrase.

decisions.choice: "그분께 있습니다" (a statement) at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the doxology as a statement, not a wish, so Korean says "있습니다". It also reads "to whom" as God and footnotes the reading "Jesus Christ"; Korean "그분" with the honorific can mean either, as the Greek can.

source.text: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος, ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε, ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι.

records.literal_gloss: Beloved, not be surprised at the among you burning for testing to you happening as strange to you happening, \v 13 but insofar as you share in the of the Christ sufferings rejoice, so that also in the revelation of the glory of him you may rejoice exulting.

en.L: Beloved, do not be surprised at the burning among you, which is happening to you for testing, as though something strange were happening to you, \v 13 but insofar as you share in the sufferings of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, rejoice, so that also at the revelation of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory you may rejoice, exulting.
en.B: Dear friends, the fire that is burning among you has come to test you; do not be taken aback by it, as though something alien to you were happening. \v 13 No, the more you share in the sufferings of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the more you should rejoice, so that you may also rejoice with shouts of joy when {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory is revealed.
en.R: Dear friends, you are going through a painful time that burns like a fire. It has come to test you. Do not be surprised by it, as if something strange were happening to you. \v 13 Instead, be glad that you are sharing in the sufferings of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. Then, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory is shown to everyone, you will be full of joy and celebrate.

es.L: Amados, no {{plural_you:se extrañen|os extrañéis}} del fuego que arde entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y que {{plural_you:les|os}} sucede para prueba, como si {{plural_you:les|os}} ocurriera algo extraño, \v 13 sino que, en la medida en que {{plural_you:participan|participáis}} de los padecimientos {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}}, para que también en la revelación de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria {{plural_you:se alegren|os alegréis}} saltando de gozo.
es.B: Queridos, el fuego que arde entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha venido para probar{{plural_you:los|os}}; no {{plural_you:se desconcierten|os desconcertéis}} por ello, como si {{plural_you:les|os}} sucediera algo ajeno. \v 13 Al contrario, cuanto más {{plural_you:participen|participéis}} en los sufrimientos {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, más {{plural_you:deben alegrarse|debéis alegraros}}, para que también {{plural_you:se alegren|os alegréis}} con gritos de gozo cuando se revele {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: Queridos amigos, {{plural_you:están|estáis}} pasando por un tiempo doloroso que quema como el fuego. Ha venido para probar{{plural_you:los|os}}. No {{plural_you:se sorprendan|os sorprendáis}}, como si {{plural_you:les|os}} estuviera pasando algo raro. \v 13 Más bien, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} de compartir los sufrimientos {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. Así, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} venga y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria se muestre a todos, {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} llenos de alegría y lo {{plural_you:celebrarán|celebraréis}}.

sw.L: Wapendwa, msishangazwe na moto unaowaka kati yenu, unaowapata ili kuwajaribu, kana kwamba jambo geni linawatokea; \v 13 bali kwa kadiri mnavyoshiriki mateso ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, furahini, ili pia wakati wa kufunuliwa kwa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mpate kufurahi mkishangilia.
sw.B: Wapendwa, moto unaowaka kati yenu umekuja kuwajaribu; msishtuke kwa sababu yake, kana kwamba jambo geni linawapata. \v 13 Badala yake, kadiri mnavyoshiriki zaidi mateso ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ndivyo mnavyopaswa kufurahi zaidi, ili mfurahi pia na kushangilia kwa sauti utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utakapofunuliwa.
sw.R: Wapendwa wangu, mnapitia wakati wa maumivu unaounguza kama moto. Umekuja ili kuwajaribu. Msishangae, kana kwamba jambo la ajabu linawatokea. \v 13 Badala yake, furahini kwamba mnashiriki mateso ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ndipo, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakapokuja na utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utakapoonyeshwa kwa wote, mtajaa furaha na kusherehekea.

fr.L: Bien-aimés, ne soyez pas surpris de l’embrasement qui est parmi vous, qui vous arrive pour [votre] épreuve, comme s’il vous arrivait quelque chose d’étrange, \v 13 mais dans la mesure où vous avez part aux souffrances du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, réjouissez-vous, afin qu’aussi, lors de la révélation de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, vous vous réjouissiez en exultant.
fr.B: Chers amis, le feu qui brûle parmi vous est venu pour vous éprouver ; n’en soyez pas déconcertés, comme s’il vous arrivait quelque chose d’étranger. \v 13 Au contraire, plus vous avez part aux souffrances du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, plus vous devez vous réjouir, afin de vous réjouir aussi avec des cris de joie quand {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sera révélée.
fr.R: Chers amis, vous traversez un temps difficile, qui brûle comme un feu. Il est venu pour vous mettre à l’épreuve. Ne soyez pas surpris, comme s’il vous arrivait quelque chose d’étrange. \v 13 Au contraire, soyez contents de partager les souffrances du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Alors, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra et que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sera montrée à tous, vous serez pleins de joie et vous ferez la fête.

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분을 시험하려고 여러분 가운데 일어나는 불 같은 시련을, 무슨 이상한 일이 여러분에게 일어나는 것처럼 이상하게 여기지 마십시오. \v 13 오히려 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 고난에 참여하는 만큼 기뻐하십시오. 그러면 그분의 영광이 나타날 때에도 여러분이 크게 즐거워하며 기뻐할 것입니다.
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분을 시험하려고 여러분 가운데 불처럼 타오르는 시련이 왔습니다. 무슨 낯선 일이 일어나는 것처럼 놀라지 마십시오. \v 13 오히려 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 고난에 더 많이 참여할수록 더 기뻐하십시오. 그러면 그분의 영광이 나타날 때에도 여러분이 기쁨에 넘쳐 즐거워할 것입니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분은 지금 불에 타는 것처럼 고통스러운 일을 겪고 있습니다. 그것은 여러분을 시험하려고 온 것입니다. 무슨 이상한 일이 일어난 것처럼 놀라지 마십시오. \v 13 오히려 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 고난에 함께 참여하게 된 것을 기뻐하십시오. 그러면 그분이 오셔서 그분의 영광이 모든 사람에게 드러날 때, 여러분은 기쁨이 넘쳐서 즐거워할 것입니다.

decisions.choice: the burning for testing: painful trouble that God uses to test and refine faith, as fire refines metal
decisions.reason: πύρωσις is a burning, used of refining metal in a furnace. The letter has already compared faith tested by trials to gold tested by fire (1:6-7). πειρασμός here is testing, not temptation to sin.

decisions.choice: do not be surprised ... as though something strange: suffering for Christ is to be expected
decisions.reason: ξενίζω is the verb used in 4:4: outsiders are surprised that the believers no longer live as they do; the believers should not be surprised that they suffer for it. ξένος, "strange", is from the same root: suffering is not foreign to the Christian life (2:21; compare John 15:18-20).

decisions.choice: share in the sufferings of Christ: suffer as he did and because of him, in fellowship with him
alternatives: add to what Christ's sufferings achieved
decisions.reason: Christ suffered once for sins (3:18); believers do not add to that. They share his sufferings when they suffer for doing good and for his name, following his steps (2:21; 4:14; compare Philippians 3:10). καθό means "to the degree that": the more they share, the more reason to rejoice.

decisions.choice: the revelation of his glory: Christ's return
decisions.reason: The letter speaks of the revealing of Jesus Christ as the day when faith tested now will result in praise, glory and honor (1:7, 1:13; 5:1, 5:4). Joy now looks forward to joy then.

decisions.choice: exulting: rejoicing with open, overflowing gladness
decisions.reason: ἀγαλλιάω is a strong word for joy, often in worship (1:6, 1:8; Matthew 5:12). Here it intensifies "rejoice".

decisions.choice: Dear friends
decisions.reason: "Beloved" is kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable use the everyday form of address, as in Philippians 2:12 and 4:1.

decisions.choice: when he comes and his glory is shown to everyone
decisions.reason: Readable makes explicit that the revealing of glory is Christ's return (m4).

decisions.choice: el fuego que arde entre ustedes
decisions.reason: "Prueba de fuego" is a common Spanish idiom, but it merges the burning and the testing that the Greek keeps apart (m1), so Spanish says "el fuego que arde" and then "para prueba" / "para probarlos".

decisions.choice: l’embrasement (L); le feu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a burning, the fire that refines metal (meaning decision m1). "Fournaise" would add the picture of an oven; "embrasement" keeps the plain burning at Literal.

decisions.choice: "불 같은 시련" (L); "불처럼 타오르는 시련" (B); "불에 타는 것처럼 고통스러운 일" (R); "시험하려고"
decisions.reason: The burning is painful trouble that God uses to test and refine faith, as fire refines metal (meaning decision). Korean keeps the picture of fire at every level and uses "시험" for the testing, as in 1:6-7.

source.text: εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ, μακάριοι, ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἀναπαύεται.

records.literal_gloss: If you are insulted in name of Christ, blessed, because the of the glory and the of the God Spirit upon you rests.

en.L: If you are insulted in [the] name of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, [you are] blessed, because the [Spirit] of glory, even the Spirit of God, rests upon you.
en.B: If you are insulted because you bear the name of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, you are blessed, since the Spirit of glory, the very Spirit of God, rests on you.
en.R: If people insult you because you belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, you are blessed. The Spirit of glory, God's own Spirit, rests on you.

es.L: Si {{plural_you:son|sois}} insultados en [el] nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, [{{plural_you:son|sois}}] bienaventurados, porque el [Espíritu] de la gloria, es decir, el Espíritu de Dios, descansa sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:los|os}} insultan por llevar el nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{plural_you:son|sois}} bienaventurados, porque el Espíritu de la gloria, el mismo Espíritu de Dios, descansa sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Si la gente {{plural_you:los|os}} insulta porque {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} bendice. El Espíritu de la gloria, el propio Espíritu de Dios, descansa sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Ikiwa mnatukanwa katika jina la {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, [mna] heri, kwa sababu [Roho] wa utukufu, yaani Roho wa Mungu, anatulia juu yenu.
sw.B: Mkitukanwa kwa sababu mnalichukua jina la {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, heri yenu, kwa kuwa Roho wa utukufu, Roho wa Mungu mwenyewe, anatulia juu yenu.
sw.R: Watu wakiwatukana kwa sababu ninyi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mmebarikiwa. Roho wa utukufu, Roho wa Mungu mwenyewe, anakaa juu yenu.

fr.L: Si vous êtes insultés au nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, [vous êtes] heureux, parce que l’[Esprit] de la gloire, c’est-à-dire l’Esprit de Dieu, repose sur vous.
fr.B: Si l’on vous insulte parce que vous portez le nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, vous êtes heureux, car l’Esprit de gloire, l’Esprit même de Dieu, repose sur vous.
fr.R: Si des gens vous insultent parce que vous appartenez au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu vous bénit. L’Esprit de gloire, l’Esprit même de Dieu, repose sur vous.

ko.L: 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름 때문에 모욕을 당하면, [여러분은] 복이 있습니다. 영광의 [영], 곧 하나님의 영께서 여러분 위에 머물러 계시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름을 지녔다는 이유로 모욕을 당하면, 여러분은 복이 있습니다. 영광의 영, 곧 하나님의 영께서 여러분 위에 머물러 계시기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속했다는 이유로 사람들이 여러분을 모욕한다면, 여러분은 복이 있습니다. 영광의 영, 곧 하나님 자신의 영께서 여러분 위에 머물러 계십니다.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of glory and of God (the SBLGNT text)
alternatives: the Spirit of glory and of power and of God
an added sentence at the end of the verse: on their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts add "and of power" after "glory". Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, add a closing sentence about the Spirit being blasphemed by the persecutors but glorified by the believers. The earliest manuscripts generally lack both, and the SBLGNT text follows them. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus before the sentence is marked meaning reviewed.

decisions.choice: one Spirit, described two ways: the Spirit of glory, who is the Spirit of God
alternatives: the glory (God's presence) and the Spirit of God, two things
decisions.reason: The Greek repeats the article: literally "the [one] of glory and the Spirit of God". The simplest reading is that both phrases describe the same Spirit. Some take the first as God's glorious presence, the glory that rested on the tabernacle; the sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: rests upon you: an echo of Isaiah 11:2
decisions.reason: Isaiah 11:2 promises that the Spirit of God will rest on the coming king from David's line. What was promised to him now rests on those insulted for his name.

decisions.choice: in the name of Christ: because they bear his name and belong to him
decisions.reason: To be insulted "in the name" of Christ is to be insulted for being his (compare Mark 9:41). Jesus called such people blessed (Matthew 5:11).

decisions.choice: because you bear the name of; because you belong to
decisions.reason: "In the name" is made clear for a reader for whom the English phrase might mean "on behalf of" (m4).

decisions.choice: bienaventurados (L, B); Dios los bendice (R)
decisions.reason: As in James 1:12, Literal and Balanced use "bienaventurados", the word of Jesus' beatitudes, which this verse echoes (m4). Readable says "Dios los bendice", as James 1:12 and 5:11 and 1 Peter 3:14 do, so the same blessing reads the same way across the letters.

decisions.choice: heureux (L, B); Dieu vous bénit (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:14: the word of the Beatitudes, which modern French renders "heureux"; Readable says where the blessing comes from.

source.text: μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος·

records.literal_gloss: Not for anyone of you let suffer as a murderer or thief or evildoer or as a meddler;

en.L: For let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as a meddler.
en.B: Of course, none of you should suffer for being a murderer or a thief or a criminal, or even for interfering in other people's affairs.
en.R: None of you should ever be punished for murder, for stealing, or for any other crime, or even for poking into other people's business.

es.L: Que ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, pues, sufra como asesino, o ladrón, o malhechor, o como entrometido.
es.B: Desde luego, ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debería sufrir por ser asesino, ladrón o delincuente, ni siquiera por meterse en los asuntos de otros.
es.R: Ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debería ser castigado nunca por matar, por robar o por cualquier otro delito, ni siquiera por meterse en la vida de los demás.

sw.L: Kwa maana yeyote kati yenu asiteseke kama muuaji, au mwizi, au mtenda maovu, au kama mtu anayeingilia mambo yasiyomhusu.
sw.B: Bila shaka, yeyote kati yenu hapaswi kuteseka kwa kuwa muuaji au mwizi au mhalifu, wala hata kwa kuingilia mambo ya watu wengine.
sw.R: Yeyote kati yenu asiadhibiwe kamwe kwa kuua, kwa kuiba, au kwa uhalifu mwingine wowote, wala hata kwa kujiingiza katika mambo ya watu wengine.

fr.L: Car qu’aucun de vous ne souffre comme meurtrier, ou voleur, ou malfaiteur, ou comme quelqu’un qui se mêle des affaires d’autrui.
fr.B: Bien sûr, aucun de vous ne devrait souffrir parce qu’il est meurtrier, voleur ou criminel, ni même parce qu’il se mêle des affaires des autres.
fr.R: Aucun de vous ne devrait jamais être puni pour un meurtre, pour un vol ou pour un autre crime, ni même parce qu’il fourre son nez dans les affaires des autres.

ko.L: 여러분 가운데 누구도 살인자나 도둑이나 악을 행하는 사람이나 남의 일에 참견하는 사람으로서 고난을 받지 마십시오.
ko.B: 물론 여러분 가운데 누구도 살인자나 도둑이나 범죄자로, 또는 남의 일에 간섭하는 사람으로 고난을 받아서는 안 됩니다.
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 누구도 살인이나 도둑질이나 다른 어떤 범죄 때문에 벌을 받아서는 안 됩니다. 남의 일에 참견하다가 벌을 받아서도 안 됩니다.

decisions.choice: a meddler: someone who interferes in matters that are not their business
alternatives: someone who misuses what belongs to others, an embezzler
decisions.reason: ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος is a rare word, built from "another's" and "overseer": someone who oversees what belongs to someone else. It is not found in any earlier Greek writing, so its sense must be guessed from its parts and the context. It is set apart from the crimes by a second "as", which suggests a lesser fault that still brings trouble on believers.

decisions.choice: evildoer: a wrongdoer, someone who breaks the law
decisions.reason: κακοποιός is the word outsiders use when they slander believers as "evildoers" (2:12); Peter wants the charge to be false (2:14; 3:16-17).

decisions.choice: for: explains why the blessing of 4:14 applies only to suffering for Christ
decisions.reason: The joy and blessing of 4:13-14 belong to suffering for Christ's name, not to punishment that a person deserves.

decisions.choice: be punished
decisions.reason: In this verse suffering "as a murderer" means suffering the penalty for a crime, so Readable says "punished".

source.text: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός, μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω, δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.

records.literal_gloss: But if as a Christian, not let him be ashamed, let him glorify but the God in the name this.

en.L: But if [anyone suffers] as a Christian, let {{gender:them|him}} not be ashamed, but let {{gender:them|him}} glorify God in this name.
en.B: But if someone suffers for being a Christian, {{gender:they|he}} should feel no shame, but should give glory to God by bearing this name.
en.R: But if you suffer because you are a Christian, do not be ashamed. Give glory to God that you are called by that name.

es.L: Pero si [sufre] como cristiano, que no se avergüence, sino que glorifique a Dios en este nombre.
es.B: Pero si alguien sufre por ser cristiano, que no sienta vergüenza, sino que dé gloria a Dios por llevar ese nombre.
es.R: Pero si {{plural_you:sufren|sufrís}} por ser cristianos, no {{plural_you:se avergüencen|os avergoncéis}}. {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gloria a Dios porque {{plural_you:los|os}} llaman por ese nombre.

sw.L: Lakini [akiteseka] kama Mkristo, asiaibike, bali amtukuze Mungu katika jina hili.
sw.B: Lakini mtu akiteseka kwa sababu ni Mkristo, asione aibu, bali ampe Mungu utukufu kwa kulichukua jina hilo.
sw.R: Lakini mkiteseka kwa sababu ni Wakristo, msione aibu. Mpeni Mungu utukufu kwa kuwa mnaitwa kwa jina hilo.

fr.L: Mais si [quelqu’un souffre] comme chrétien, qu’il n’ait pas honte, mais qu’il glorifie Dieu dans ce nom.
fr.B: Mais si quelqu’un souffre parce qu’il est chrétien, il ne doit pas en avoir honte ; qu’il rende plutôt gloire à Dieu de porter ce nom.
fr.R: Mais si vous souffrez parce que vous êtes chrétiens, n’ayez pas honte. Rendez gloire à Dieu d’être appelés de ce nom.

ko.L: 그러나 [누가] 그리스도인으로서 [고난을 받는다면], 그는 부끄러워하지 말고 이 이름으로 하나님께 영광을 돌려야 합니다.
ko.B: 그러나 누가 그리스도인이라는 이유로 고난을 받는다면, 부끄러워하지 말고 그 이름을 지닌 사람으로서 하나님께 영광을 돌려야 합니다.
ko.R: 그러나 여러분이 그리스도인이기 때문에 고난을 받는다면, 부끄러워하지 마십시오. 그 이름으로 불리는 것을 두고 하나님께 영광을 돌리십시오.

decisions.choice: Christian: a name for believers used by outsiders, possibly as a charge
decisions.reason: Χριστιανός appears only three times in the New Testament: here, Acts 11:26, where the disciples were first called Christians at Antioch, and Acts 26:28, on the lips of King Agrippa. It was a label others gave them, "Christ's people". To suffer "as a Christian" is to suffer for nothing but bearing that name.

decisions.choice: in this name (the SBLGNT text)
alternatives: in this matter, in this respect
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, read "in this matter" instead of "in this name". The earliest manuscripts generally read "name", and the SBLGNT text follows them. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus before the sentence is marked meaning reviewed.

decisions.choice: in this name: because they bear the name "Christian"
decisions.reason: The name that brings shame in the eyes of others is the reason to glorify God. The phrase can also mean that they glorify God by bearing the name well; the renderings allow both.

decisions.choice: them / they, with him / he as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: The command is for any believer, man or woman. The traditional form is available through the gender setting.

decisions.choice: if you suffer ... do not be ashamed
alternatives: if anyone suffers ... let them not be ashamed
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the readers directly instead of using a third-person command. It applies to each of them just the same.

decisions.choice: que no se avergüence, sino que glorifique; no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The English needs "them" / "him" for the subject of the commands. Spanish verbs carry the person without a pronoun ("que no se avergüence"), so there is nothing for the gender setting to change and Spanish has no span here.

decisions.choice: asiaibike, amtukuze; no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "them" / "him" for the subject of the commands. Swahili marks the person in the verb ("asione aibu", "amtukuze") with no sex distinction, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change.

decisions.choice: quelqu’un ... qu’il (L, B), without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "{{gender:them|him}}" for the pronoun. In French "quelqu’un" already means anyone, and the "il" that refers back to it is ordinary generic French, so no span is needed (French style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: chrétien, lowercase
decisions.reason: French writes the noun for a member of a religion in lowercase. The word was a name used by outsiders (meaning decision m1), and French keeps it as a plain noun.

decisions.choice: "그리스도인" with no christos span
decisions.reason: The English "Christian" has no setting either: it is the name outsiders gave believers (meaning decision), a word of its own, not the title Christ. "그리스도인" is that name in Korean.

source.text: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφ’ ἡμῶν, τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ;

records.literal_gloss: Because the time [is] for the judgment to begin from the house of God; if but first from us, what the end of those disobeying the of God gospel?

en.L: For [it is] the time for the judgment to begin from the house of God; and if [it begins] first from us, what [will be] the end of those who disobey the gospel of God?
en.B: For now is the time for judgment to start, and it starts at God's own house. If we are the first to face it, how will it end for those who refuse to obey God's gospel?
en.R: The time has come for God to begin judging, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is starting with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own family. If the judging starts with us, what will happen in the end to people who refuse to obey God's good news?

es.L: Porque [ha llegado] el momento de que el juicio empiece desde la casa de Dios; y si [empieza] primero desde nosotros, ¿cuál [será] el fin de los que desobedecen al evangelio de Dios?
es.B: Porque ahora es el momento de que comience el juicio, y comienza por la propia casa de Dios. Si nosotros somos los primeros en enfrentarlo, ¿cómo terminarán los que se niegan a obedecer el evangelio de Dios?
es.R: Ha llegado el momento de que Dios comience a juzgar, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} empieza por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia familia. Si el juicio empieza por nosotros, ¿qué pasará al final con los que se niegan a obedecer la buena noticia de Dios?

sw.L: Kwa maana [ni] wakati wa hukumu kuanzia nyumba ya Mungu; na ikiwa [inaanza] kwanza kwetu, ni nini mwisho wa wale wasioitii Injili ya Mungu?
sw.B: Kwa maana sasa ni wakati wa hukumu kuanza, nayo inaanzia katika nyumba ya Mungu mwenyewe. Ikiwa sisi ndio wa kwanza kuikabili, itakuwaje mwishoni kwa wale wanaokataa kuitii Injili ya Mungu?
sw.R: Sasa ni wakati wa Mungu kuanza kuhukumu, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anaanza na familia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe. Ikiwa hukumu inaanza na sisi, nini kitawapata mwishoni watu wanaokataa kuitii Habari Njema ya Mungu?

fr.L: Car [c’est] le moment pour le jugement de commencer par la maison de Dieu ; et s’il [commence] d’abord par nous, quelle [sera] la fin de ceux qui désobéissent à l’Évangile de Dieu ?
fr.B: Car le moment est venu où le jugement commence, et il commence par la maison de Dieu. Si c’est nous qui y faisons face les premiers, comment cela finira-t-il pour ceux qui refusent d’obéir à l’Évangile de Dieu ?
fr.R: Le moment est venu où Dieu commence à juger, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commence par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre famille. Si le jugement commence par nous, qu’arrivera-t-il à la fin à ceux qui refusent d’obéir à la bonne nouvelle de Dieu ?

ko.L: 심판이 하나님의 집에서부터 시작될 때가 되었기 때문입니다. 그런데 [심판이] 먼저 우리에게서 [시작된다면], 하나님의 복음에 순종하지 않는 사람들의 마지막은 어떠하겠습니까?
ko.B: 이제 심판이 시작될 때가 되었는데, 그 심판은 하나님의 집에서부터 시작됩니다. 우리가 먼저 심판을 받는다면, 하나님의 복음에 순종하기를 거부하는 사람들의 마지막은 어떻게 되겠습니까?
ko.R: 하나님께서 심판을 시작하실 때가 되었습니다. 하나님께서는 그분의 가족부터 심판하십니다. 심판이 우리부터 시작된다면, 하나님의 기쁜 소식에 순종하기를 거부하는 사람들은 마지막에 어떻게 되겠습니까?

decisions.choice: judgment beginning at God's house: an echo of the prophets
decisions.reason: In Ezekiel 9:6 God's judgment on Jerusalem begins "at my sanctuary", and in Malachi 3:1-3 the Lord comes to his temple to purify it like a refiner's fire. Compare Jeremiah 25:29: if disaster begins with the city called by God's name, the other nations will not escape.

decisions.choice: the house of God: God's people, the church, as his temple and household
decisions.reason: The letter calls the believers a spiritual house being built (2:5). οἶκος can mean both a building and a household; here it is the community of believers.

decisions.choice: the judgment: the present suffering of believers as God's refining judgment
decisions.reason: The "fiery" testing of 4:12 is God's judgment beginning with his own people, to purify them, as 1:6-7 explains. It is a foretaste of the final judgment that will fall on those who reject the gospel.

decisions.choice: the end of those who disobey: their final outcome
decisions.reason: τέλος is the word of 4:7, "the end of all things". ἀπειθέω is to disobey or refuse to believe; the letter uses it of those who reject the word (2:8; 3:1, 3:20).

decisions.choice: God begins judging, starting with his own family
alternatives: judgment begins with the house of God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the judge and says "family" for "house", the household sense of m2.

source.text: καὶ εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σῴζεται, ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται;

records.literal_gloss: And if the righteous with difficulty is saved, the ungodly and sinner where will appear?

en.L: And "if the righteous one is saved with difficulty, where will the ungodly and sinner appear?"
en.B: And, "If the righteous are saved only with difficulty, what place will there be for the godless and the sinner?"
en.R: As Scripture says, "If it is hard even for people who do right to be saved, what will happen to those who reject God and live in sin?"

es.L: Y «si el justo es salvado con dificultad, ¿dónde aparecerá el impío y pecador?»
es.B: Y: «Si los justos se salvan a duras penas, ¿qué lugar quedará para el impío y el pecador?»
es.R: Como dice la Escritura: «Si incluso para los que hacen el bien es difícil salvarse, ¿qué será de los que rechazan a Dios y viven en el pecado?»

sw.L: Na, "Ikiwa mwenye haki anaokolewa kwa taabu, asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi atajitokeza wapi?"
sw.B: Na, "Ikiwa wenye haki wanaokolewa kwa shida tu, kutakuwa na nafasi gani kwa asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?"
sw.R: Kama Maandiko yanavyosema, "Ikiwa ni vigumu hata kwa watu wanaotenda haki kuokolewa, itakuwaje kwa wale wanaomkataa Mungu na kuishi katika dhambi?"

fr.L: Et « si le juste est sauvé avec peine, où paraîtront l’impie et le pécheur ? »
fr.B: Et : « Si le juste n’est sauvé qu’avec peine, quelle place y aura-t-il pour l’impie et le pécheur ? »
fr.R: Comme le dit l’Écriture : « S’il est difficile, même pour ceux qui font le bien, d’être sauvés, qu’arrivera-t-il à ceux qui rejettent Dieu et vivent dans le péché ? »

ko.L: 그리고 "의인이 겨우 구원을 받는다면, 경건하지 않은 사람과 죄인은 어디에 나타나겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그리고 "의로운 사람도 겨우 구원을 받는다면, 경건하지 않은 사람과 죄인은 어떤 자리에 서겠느냐?" 하였습니다.
ko.R: 성경은 이렇게 말합니다. "옳은 일을 하는 사람도 구원을 받기가 어렵다면, 하나님을 거부하고 죄 가운데 사는 사람들은 어떻게 되겠느냐?"

decisions.choice: a quotation of Proverbs 11:31, in its old Greek form
