decisions.reason: The words match the old Greek translation of Proverbs 11:31 exactly. The Hebrew of that verse says that if the righteous are repaid on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner. The Greek version speaks instead of the righteous being saved with difficulty, which suits Peter's point: if God's people come through only by way of suffering, the ungodly have no hope.

decisions.choice: saved with difficulty: brought through to final salvation only by way of trial
alternatives: barely saved, as though salvation were in doubt
decisions.reason: μόλις means with difficulty. The letter is sure of the believers' salvation (1:3-5); the difficulty is the hard road of suffering by which they reach it (1:6-7; 4:12).

decisions.choice: where will they appear: what will become of them at the judgment
decisions.reason: To ask where they will appear is to say they will have no place to stand when God judges (compare Psalm 1:5).

decisions.choice: As Scripture says
decisions.reason: Readable signals that the words are a quotation (m1). Literal and Balanced use quotation marks after "And".

decisions.choice: people who do right; those who reject God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "righteous" and "ungodly" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "경건하지 않은 사람" (L, B); "하나님을 거부하는 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: "경건" is kept for godliness, the word 2 Peter uses often; its opposite here is the godless (meaning decision), which Readable says plainly. The quotation of Proverbs is in 해라체.

source.text: ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ πιστῷ κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: So that also those suffering according to the will of the God to a faithful Creator let them entrust the souls of them in doing good.

en.L: So then also those who suffer according to the will of God, let them entrust their souls to a faithful Creator in doing good.
en.B: So, then, those who suffer as God wills should place themselves in the hands of the Creator, who is faithful, while they keep on doing what is good.
en.R: So if you are suffering because that is what God has allowed for you, trust yourself to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He made you, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} always keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises. And keep on doing what is good.

es.L: Por tanto, también los que sufren según la voluntad de Dios, que confíen sus almas a un Creador fiel, practicando el bien.
es.B: Así pues, los que sufren conforme a la voluntad de Dios, que se pongan en manos del Creador, que es fiel, mientras siguen haciendo el bien.
es.R: Así que, si {{plural_you:están|estáis}} sufriendo porque eso es lo que Dios ha permitido para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} creó, y siempre cumple {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas. Y {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} haciendo el bien.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo hata wale wanaoteseka kwa kadiri ya mapenzi ya Mungu, na wakabidhi nafsi zao kwa Muumba aliye mwaminifu, huku wakitenda mema.
sw.B: Basi, wale wanaoteseka kama Mungu apendavyo na wajiweke mikononi mwa Muumba, aliye mwaminifu, huku wakiendelea kutenda mema.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, kama mnateseka kwa sababu ndivyo Mungu alivyoruhusu kwenu, jikabidhini {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Yeye ndiye aliyewaumba, naye hutimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} siku zote. Tena endeleeni kutenda mema.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, que ceux aussi qui souffrent selon la volonté de Dieu confient leurs âmes à un Créateur fidèle, en faisant le bien.
fr.B: Ainsi, que ceux qui souffrent selon la volonté de Dieu remettent leur vie entre les mains du Créateur, qui est fidèle, tout en continuant à faire le bien.
fr.R: Alors, si vous souffrez parce que Dieu l’a permis pour vous, confiez-vous à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il vous a créés, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tient toujours {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses. Et continuez à faire le bien.

ko.L: 그러므로 하나님의 뜻을 따라 고난을 받는 사람들도 선을 행하면서 그들의 영혼을 신실하신 창조주께 맡겨야 합니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 하나님의 뜻에 따라 고난을 받는 사람들은 계속 선한 일을 하면서, 신실하신 창조주의 손에 자신을 맡겨야 합니다.
ko.R: 그러니 하나님께서 허락하셔서 고난을 받고 있다면, 여러분 자신을 하나님께 맡기십시오. 하나님께서는 여러분을 만드셨고, 언제나 약속을 지키십니다. 그리고 계속 선한 일을 하십시오.

decisions.choice: according to the will of God: suffering that God has allowed in his purpose, for doing right
decisions.reason: The letter has said that it may be God's will that believers suffer for doing good (3:17). God does not delight in their pain, but nothing they suffer is outside his purpose.

decisions.choice: entrust their souls: put their whole selves, their lives, in God's safekeeping
decisions.reason: παρατίθημι means to deposit something with someone for safekeeping. ψυχή here is the whole person and their life. Jesus used the same verb on the cross: "into your hands I entrust my spirit" (Luke 23:46, quoting Psalm 31:6).

decisions.choice: a faithful Creator: the God who made them and can be relied on to keep them
decisions.reason: κτίστης is found only here in the New Testament. The one who made all things has the power to keep what is entrusted to him, and he is faithful to his promises (1:3-5).

decisions.choice: in doing good: while continuing to do good
decisions.reason: ἀγαθοποιΐα is the doing of good the letter has called for throughout (2:15, 2:20; 3:6, 3:17). Trusting God does not mean giving up doing right.

decisions.choice: if you are suffering ... trust yourself
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the readers directly, as elsewhere in the chapter.

decisions.choice: He made you, and he always keeps his promises
decisions.reason: Readable explains "faithful Creator" in two plain statements (m3).

decisions.choice: nafsi zao
decisions.reason: "Roho" is also the word for the Spirit and could suggest one part of a person. "Nafsi" is the self, the whole person and life, as the meaning decision explains (m2), and matches James 5:20. Balanced and Readable say "wajiweke" / "jikabidhini" (place themselves), as the English does.
